test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All chairs are doors.

Some doors are keys.

All keys are windows.

**Conclusions:**

I. All chairs are keys.

II. Some windows are doors.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
From the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

All chairs are doors.

Some doors are keys.
